Property expertise. Practical technology. Dependable local support.

Aloha Technology Services LLC is locally owned and operated on Hawaiʻi Island. Our services are organized around Property Field Services, Home Inspections, Vendor Coordination, Handyman Services, Workflow Optimization, Technology Installation, Training and Support, Website Development, Insight & Analysis, Automation Development, AI Implementation and Application Development.

Home Inspections

Residential inspections for buyers, sellers, owners, new construction, repair verification, moisture and water intrusion, irrigation, pools and spas, condos and rental arrival/departure documentation.

Property Field Services

Owner-directed visual checks, photographs, factual notes, authorized vendor access, delivery verification and incident documentation. No leasing or property-management authority.

Vendor Coordination

Project-specific provider research supported by an internal directory covering 316 unique Hawaiʻi Island providers across 39 separated service families, with current verification required before regulated referrals.
